basics.name: Ross Jenkinson

work.summary: Continuing research in theoretical physics, focusing on quantum information theory and quantum field theory applications to quantum technologies.
highlights: Research in qubit simulations of quantum field theory

work.summary: Completed PhD in Theoretical Particle Physics under supervision of Prof. Brian Cox and Prof. Jeff Forshaw.
highlights: Developed manifestly causal approaches to quantum field theory
Research on Unruh effect and black hole physics
Teaching tutorials, Python programming courses, and examples classes
Thesis: 'A Manifestly Causal Approach to Quantum Field Theory'
